System and Renewable Data Reports

Data relating to system and renewable energy use in our electricity system.

Renewable Energy

The electricity system on the island is undergoing a transformation. We are integrating renewable energy and new technologies more and more.

The electricity sector will play a key role in shaping a sustainable energy future for Ireland and Northern Ireland. Our role is to operate a secure electricity system, while achieving our 2030 renewable electricity targets. Shaping Our Electricity Future is our plan to meet this challenge.

Learn more about Shaping Our Electricity Future
